paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: (left) and (right) on GSM8K with different settings: decoding length L, sampling steps S, refresh intervals and the window size.
model_annotation: The diagram illustrates the relationship between Performance (Accuracy %) and Speed (Tokens/s) for various settings of decoding length L, sampling steps S, refresh intervals, and window size. The x-axis represents Speed (Tokens/s) on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 160, with tick labels at regular intervals of 20. The y-axis represents Performance (Accuracy %) on a linear scale, ranging from 65 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. There are two lines representing Pareto Fronts: one labeled LLaDA Pareto Front, shown as a dotted gray line, and another labeled Cache Pareto Front, depicted as a dashed dark gray line. Additionally, there are several lines representing different combinations of L and S values: a blue line with square markers for L=512, S=512; a blue line with circle markers for L=512, S=256; a blue line with cross markers for L=512, S=128; a red line with square markers for L=128, S=64; and a light red line with circle markers for L=128, S=32. A legend in the bottom-left corner describes different refresh settings: w/o Cache, Refresh=2, Refresh=4, Refresh=8, and Refresh=16. The blue line with square markers starts at approximately (10, 82) and ends at approximately (20, 79), while the blue line with circle markers starts at approximately (10, 81) and ends at approximately (40, 78). The blue line with cross markers starts at approximately (10, 80) and ends at approximately (60, 75). The red line with square markers starts at approximately (60, 72) and ends at approximately (110, 62). The light red line with circle markers starts at approximately (80, 71) and ends at approximately (160, 64).

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between performance, measured as accuracy percentage, and speed, measured in tokens per second, across various configurations. The x-axis represents speed, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160 tokens/s and tick labels at regular intervals of 20. The y-axis represents performance, with a linear scale ranging from 65% to 80% and tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot features multiple lines, each representing a different configuration: L=512, S=512 (blue, solid, with circle markers) starts at approximately (18, 82) and decreases to (140, 68); L=512, S=256 (blue, dashed, with square markers) starts at approximately (18, 82) and decreases to (100, 74); L=512, S=128 (blue, dotted, with cross markers) starts at approximately (18, 81) and decreases to (80, 73); L=128, S=64 (orange, solid, with circle markers) starts at approximately (60, 72) and decreases to (140, 65); L=128, S=32 (orange, dashed, with square markers) starts at approximately (80, 70) and decreases to (140, 65). Additionally, two pareto fronts are shown: LLaDA Pareto Front (dotted gray line) and Cache Pareto Front (dashed dark gray line).
